api_evidence: Installed Alchemy beta.80 Test/Core.deploy and destroy with dev:false, state:Cloudflare.state(), and noninteractive prompt handling. AlchemyContext.updateStateStore remains false.

Installed Alchemy auth resolver intentionally ignores saved profiles under CI=true. The predeployment CI invocation failed before resource creation; hosted execution uses CI=false and the existing default OAuth profile.
Existing shared state store returned version 7, matching installed STATE_STORE_VERSION. No local bootstrap-resume stage existed. Shared Worker metadata is unchanged after cleanup.
Cloudflare Durable Object State abort API: https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/api/state/ retrieved 2026-10-12; abort resets an object and terminates the active request.

Browser Run pricing: https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-run/pricing/ retrieved 2026-10-12. Browser execution was excluded because the dashboard range omitted part of the Workers billing period and billing API reads returned 403.

inputs: One synthetic question and fixed offline answer synthetic-done-v1
One unique thread per attempt, idempotency key first
Two SQL migrations and 16 concurrent conditional updates per store
SHA-256 abc/empty vectors; 32 UUIDv4 samples; negative random-byte size
Fresh in-memory probe secret, never logged or persisted in evidence
procedure: Read-only profile/account inventory and state-store version check; reserve one temporary stage against the included-allowance budget.
Freeze executed source and lockfile before deploying.
CI=false ALCHEMY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 FLOOR_EXECUTE_HOSTED_PROBE=true bun run apps/floor/test/hosted.run.ts
Install cleanup before deploy; use one unique stage and cap driver requests at 80, work at 20 minutes and cleanup at 4 minutes.
Require 403 without the secret before authenticated mutations. Attempt 002 retries at most five transient readiness responses and records bounded, secret-redacted error diagnostics.
Observe a six-second request-free interval for callback/agent alarms, test SQL behavior, abort only the test storage DO, verify retained rows, test duplicate admission and execute Web Crypto.
Destroy the exact stage in the finalizer; independently list Worker, DO, D1 and Secrets Store identities and compare with the original inventory.
expected_result: Native callback and agent alarm complete without polling; SQL migrations/rollback/conditional updates behave as locally observed; data survives storage DO reset; duplicate admission preserves agent records; Web Crypto vectors pass; stage is destroyed without changing pre-existing resources.
observed_result: Deployment succeeded, but the initial unauthenticated gate invariant failed. The first driver did not retain its unexpected HTTP status/body, so no cause is assigned. All created resources were destroyed and the baseline identity sets restored.

policy_and_cost.network_policy: Controlled Cloudflare management endpoints and temporary workers.dev endpoints only. No browser, model provider, wallet, chain RPC or broadcast. This is not an open-web containment result.
policy_and_cost.budget: docs/spikes/hosted-budget.json; one concurrent temporary stage, no new subscription or task-caused overage, no R2. Combined driver count across attempts is 13. Per-request Worker CPU limit is 10,000 ms; included account headroom was checked before execution.
policy_and_cost.observed_cost: Exact incremental cost is unknown because usage is account-wide and billing can lag. No paid outside-provider operation or Browser session was invoked. Resources were short-lived and the executed workload remained within the declared reservation.
